settings.content:
Mounting / Assembly Service

Take the stress out of mounting / assembly with William Wood. We have partnered with Taskrabbit, the largest home services site in the Germany, to make mounting your mirror or assembling your furniture easier than ever to save you time. Find the help you need from less than €20,00 an hour, with services available all over the Germany.

After purchasing your new William Wood product, you will notice that we provide options for professional furniture assembly / mirror mounting services via Taskrabbit on your post purchase confirmation email. Click on one of the provided links and enter your full address to find all the available Taskers in your area.

Please note that whilst you may be able to book a Tasker to assemble / mount your new William Wood products on the same day as we deliver, we advise you to book your Tasker for the next day to avoid any timing issues.

Simply click the link below, add your full address and you will be shown all the furniture assembly Taskers available in your area.

settings.liquid:
BOOK MIRROR MOUNTING SERVICE
BOOK FURNITURE ASSEMBLY SERVICE

settings.title: How long do tasks take?
settings.answer: Time can vary according to how many products you require mounting / assembling – a single mirror / coffee table will usually take less than one hour to mount / assemble.

settings.title: How much do tasks cost?
settings.answer: The cost of mounting / assembling your William Wood product will depend on the Tasker you choose from Taskrabbit – their prices will be listed when you enter your address, and you can choose the best price for your budget. Taskers bill on an hourly basis and you will receive a final bill once the job has been complete based on the time taken.

settings.title: What products apply?
settings.answer:
We offer occasional furniture, some of which are delivered flat packed. Should you wish, you can use Taskrabbit taskers to build the flat packed furniture for you. Please note, some of our occasional furniture does not require assembly. To identify which products do not require assembly, please look out for this icon on the product page "Delivered fully assembled for your convenience".

We offer an extensive range of mirrors. Should you wish, you can use Taskrabbit taskers to mount your mirror(s) on your wall for you.

Taskrabbit has Taskers capable of assembling / mounting a wide range of furniture / mirrors. Taskers will follow all instructions provided.

settings.title: Dont's
settings.answer:
• Book a Tasker until you have taken receipt of your order.
  • Book a Tasker until you have confirmed you are satisfied with the quality of your item(s).
  • Book an assembly service for furniture which does not require assembly (please look out for the icon above on the product). Note: Trays, Vases & Lamps DO NOT require an assembly service.

settings.title: Terms and Conditions
settings.answer:
• Taskrabbit is the preferred partner of William Wood for furniture assembly / mirror mounting.
  • Before arranging an appointment via Taskrabbit, please ensure that you are happy to abide by the terms and conditions set by Taskrabbit.
  • William Wood is not responsible for any issues caused by third parties, including missed or late appointments, damages or required repairs. Any such instances can be taken up separately with Taskrabbit.

Partner Disclosure

You are welcome to use any supplier for your assembly, but William Wood have chosen a trusted supplier so you can be assured of satisfaction. William Wood will earn a small commission if you choose Taskrabbit for your assembly.
